name: Apply Ceiling Primer (Spray + Backroll, Combined Wall+Ceiling Pass)
intent: Ceiling prime variant for the pre-trim NC workflow where walls and ceiling are primed in one continuous spray pass. Identical to MOD_APPLY_CEIL_PRIME_SPRAY_BACKROLL except drops the post-spray wall-line cut-in — wall spray covers that edge, so no dedicated cut-in is needed. Rates and modifier sensitivities match the standalone ceiling prime module so estimation remains consistent.
doctrine: Combined wall+ceiling prime variant — no cut-in (the wall scenario's spray covers the ceiling-wall edge in one pass). Universal field tasks (TSK_SPRAY_CEILING_FINISH 450, TSK_BACKROLL_CEILING_FINISH 320) with FAC_MATERIAL → WB_PRIMER 1.25× time multiplier. Pairs with MOD_APPLY_WALL_PRIME_SPRAY_BACKROLL_COMBINED inside SCN_COMBINED_WALLS_CEILING_PRIME_*.
